{"consolidated_memory":"## Empty Result Set in search/query/rewriter.ts — Two Separate Incidents

**Shared characteristics across both occasions:**
- File: search/query/rewriter.ts (search side)
- Problem: empty result set in the query rewriter
- Repro case: search for a two word phrase containing a stop word
- Signal: a rewritten query with no clauses left
- Tech stack: TypeScript; test coverage in search/query/rewriter.test.ts

---

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-14] Off-by-One Slice Bound Error
- **Manifestation:** appeared only on the staging read replica
- **Root cause:** an off-by-one error in the slice bound
- **Fix:** corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR:** #1367 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
- **Outcome:** flaky test went from 85 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Occasion 2: [2026-05-25] Unbounded Retry Loop
- **Manifestation:** appeared only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Root cause:** an unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix:** capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- **PR:** #2019 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
- **Outcome:** p99 latency fell from 8.2 s to 645 ms
- **Note:** same corner of search/query/rewriter.ts as the earlier fix; context carried over from first incident"}
